items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: You couldn't tell the difference between us and Guy Lombardo if you heard a record, that's how much he imitated him, right to the letter.

ctx.x: exactly like Guy Lombardo. You couldn't tell -- This was a black band?

Yeah. You couldn't tell the difference between us and Guy Lombardo if you heard a record, that's how much he imitated him, right to the letter. So it was a club owner in Cincinnati who loved Guy Lombardo, so what did he do? He hired us.
